scenarios.notes: real key presses with wtype on the open desk at Work (7 completed cases): Up from the first row puts the cursor on By agent (no row selected, the hint "←/→ a button · Enter twice runs it · ↓ back to the list"), Right Import tasks…, Right New case, Enter arms it ("New case? Press Enter again."), Left cancels and moves to Import tasks…, Left By agent, Down back to the first row; on By agent Enter twice turned the filter on (COMPLETED 7 to 1) and Enter twice off again; the focus ring on the button under the cursor (shot)

scenarios.title: a privileged command with a secret inside a command substitution, recorded masked (WP-209)
scenarios.notes: a PreToolUse payload (Bash, cwd the host's logbook ~/Seldon) piped into seldon hook claude-code, nothing executed: x=$(sudo mkpasswd -m sha-512 <a made-up secret>); echo "$x". Exit 0; one new ledger line, zone red, actor agent:claude-code, subject mkpasswd, text "asked to run: mkpasswd ‹redacted›"; the secret is in no file under ~/Seldon or ~/.local/state/seldon. The guard did not block the payload
